chapter_title_en: The Awakening of the War God
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 309: The Awakening of the War God Xing Tian
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen and Chi You break the seal on Changyang Mountain, awakening the legendary war god Xing Tian. A new era begins for the mortal world.
og_title: Xing Tian Rises: Changyang Mountain Sundered
og_description: The severed head of Xing Tian is freed from his petrified prison. With starlight rebuilding his body, he vows to expel the invaders from the Nine Provinces.
twitter_title: War God Unsealed: Xing Tian Awakens
twitter_description: Chi You and Xiao Chen use the Xuanyuan Sword to break the ancient seal, releasing the indomitable Xing Tian. The mortal world gains a new champion.
